title: Financial Data Continuity Framework (FDCF): toolkit for verifying financial records across ERP migrations
description: Open-source toolkit implementing the Financial Data Continuity Framework: a pre-registered acceptance registry, a three-level go-live gate (records, balances, reports), control-chart monitoring through the first closes, and a lineage and AI-readiness record. Includes SAP ECC to S/4HANA and PeopleSoft to cloud ERP reference paths and a seeded-error validation study on synthetic data.
